title: Electric car chargers aren't chargers at all – EVSE Explained
summary: Technology Connections explains that the so-called EV charger in an electric car's charging cable or wall unit is really an EVSE, a smart switch that safely delivers AC power. The actual charger is inside the car. The video covers the safety signaling and mechanisms involved.
why: HN recommends it as the clearest introduction to what is inside an AC EV charging station and why it is much simpler than people assume.

quote.text: A quick intro into EVSE and why there is no power 'charger' in them
